notes.title: Rollback Netcode Beta for Persona 4 Arena Ultimax
notes.content:
Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Rollback Netcode Beta 

Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! 
 
The time has finally come! Our Rollback Netcode Opt-In Beta for Persona 4 Arena Ultimax is now live. If you would like to opt in, please do the following: 
 
From Persona 4 Arena Ultimax in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code: 
 
p4auopenbeta03 
 
From the drop down menu, select “open_beta_3”. 
 
Features and changes included in this beta: 

[list]
[*] Implements Rollback Netcode for online play 
[*] Improvements to game stability and minor bug fixes. 
[*] Fixing an issue in which saved replay data was not properly being saved to the cloud. 
[*] Improved stability of beta.
[/list]
 
ATLUS Comms

*UPDATE 8/11/2022*

Thank you for participating in our Opt-In Beta and sharing your feedback! The latest update to the Beta branch addresses an issue where crashing would occur when playing the game for prolonged periods of time.   

A number of players are experiencing pauses during gameplay. We are currently looking in to fixing this issue, and will provide an update when the issue is resolved.

Thank you for playing! 

ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! This release is Persona 4 Arena Ultimax, version 1.0.2. 
 
Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our hotfix release! This binary update rolls issues that were addressed in Beta 2 into the main branch. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made: [list] 
 

[*]Increased game stability to address an issue where certain graphic card drivers would cause the game to crash on the character select screen. 

[*] Improved game stability to reduce occurrence of drops in framerate 

[*] Adjusted overall game volume from user feedback. 

[*] Fixed an issue where the game crashes when playing on full screen with multiple monitors. Now if the monitor the game is being displayed on is removed during play of after the application is closed, it will not cause the game to crash. 

[*] Fixed an issue where certain sound effects would overlap each other to create unintended sounds. 

[*] Fixed an issue so that keyboard button configurations will not return to default every time the application is opened. 

[*] Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game pauses or not when not in focus. 

[*] Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game mutes or not when not in focus. 

[*] Added a volume control bar for the Movie scenes in Sound & Language Options. 

[*] Fixed an issue where the game would not display centered depending on monitor resolution. [/list] 

 
Thank you for playing! 
 
ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Opt-In Beta 2
notes.content:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! 

Thank you for reporting your issues with Persona 4 Arena Ultimax. 

Our team has addressed additional issues and has rolled the fixes into the beta branch. This is an opt-in beta, so if you would like to opt in, please do the following: 

From Persona 4 Arena Ultimax in your Steam library, right click and go to Properties. Navigate to the BETAS tab and enter the beta access code:  

p4auopenbeta2 

From the drop down menu, select “open_beta_2”. 

Issues addressed in this beta: [list] 

[*]Increased game stability to address an issue where certain graphic card drivers would cause the game to crash on the character select screen. 

[*] Adjusted overall game volume from user feedback. 

[*] Fixed an issue where the game crashes when playing on full screen with multiple monitors. Now if the monitor the game is being displayed on is removed during play or after the application is closed, it will not cause the game to crash. 

[*] Fixed an issue where certain sound effects would overlap each other to create unintended sounds. 

[*] Fixed an issue so that keyboard button configurations will not return to default every time the application is opened. 

[*] Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game pauses or not when not in focus. 

[*] Added an option in the System Options where the player can toggle whether the game mutes or not when not in focus. 

[*] Added a volume control bar for the Movie scenes in Sound & Language Options. [/list] 

UPDATE 4/11/22
We have updated the beta to address the following issues:
[list][*]Fixed an issue where if the game is set to not not mute when not in focus, the game's BGM will stop after a scene shift.
[*]Fixed an issue where the game would not display centered depending on monitor resolution.[/list]

If you are not experiencing any major issues, we recommend not opting into the beta branch. 

Please post issues in this thread regarding this beta so that we can further identify technical issues. We appreciate your feedback and information you provided us. 

Thank you! 

ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello Persona 4 Arena Ultimax Players! This release is Persona 4 Arena Ultimax, version 1.0.1. 

Thank you for reporting issues and participating in our hotfix release! This binary update rolls issues that were addressed in Beta 1 into the main branch. Here is a comprehensive list of fixes made: [list]

[*]Addressed an issue in which the game would crash when searching for online matches. 

[*]Improved stability of the build which should reduce occurrence of "intrenderer" errors. 

[*]Addressed an issue where the game would minimize itself on startup. 

[*]Addressed an issue where usernames would display as blank during Rank Match searches.[/list] 

Additionally,  we recommend that players make sure their graphic drivers are updated to the latest versions, and to play in Windowed mode to further increase stability.  

Thank you for playing! 

ATLUS Comms

notes.title: Rollback Netcode is coming to Persona 4 Arena Ultimax!
notes.content:
And the crowd goes wild – Rollback Netcode will be implemented this summer for the Steam version of Persona 4 Arena Ultimax!  

[previewyoutube=Vig_vVBMRQk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]What is Rollback Netcode? [/b]

Rollback netcode is a feature that helps to make online matches as smooth as possible, regardless of the other player’s connection.  

[b]When is rollback coming?[/b] 

We’re working with Arc System Works to implement Rollback Netcode as soon as possible, and we anticipate the update going live [b]Summer 2022[/b]. Stay tuned for more updates!
